headline: Deploy {arm:brisk-s.few}. It is the only configuration to clear all accuracy floors within the latency budget.
lede: {arm:brisk-s.few} delivers {measure.balanced_accuracy.brisk-s.few.mean|pct} balanced accuracy with a p95 latency of {measure.latency_ms.brisk-s.few.p95} ms. Lowering the cell accuracy floor below {criteria.cell_floor.threshold|pct} would allow {arm:nano-xs.few} at lower cost.

slots.text: Select {arm:brisk-s.few}. It satisfies the {criteria.overall.threshold|pct} overall target, clears the {criteria.cell_floor.threshold|pct} floor across every cell, and stays under the {criteria.p95.threshold} ms latency cap.
{arm:nano-xs.few} breaches the {criteria.cell_floor.threshold|pct} floor on complex news. Every Atlas-M configuration exceeds the {criteria.p95.threshold} ms latency budget.

{weakest.arm} achieves {weakest.value|pct} against {weakest.criterion} at {weakest.threshold|pct}, a margin of {weakest.margin|pts}. Production drifts toward complex news could compromise classification quality.
Run a targeted prompt trial on {arm:nano-xs.few} specifically for complex news turns to test if its cell floor failure can be eliminated.

method.text: {scoreboard.brisk-s.few.cases} labelled evaluation turns evaluated across three complexity tiers and three domain categories.
Balanced accuracy at or above {criteria.overall.threshold|pct}, every cell at or above {criteria.cell_floor.threshold|pct}, and latency under {criteria.p95.threshold} ms.
Deterministic exact match against ground truth complexity and domain annotations.
Standard errors and half-widths calculated at normal confidence intervals per cell.
Measured prompt and generation token counts multiplied by published model catalog pricing.

sections.headline: {arm:brisk-s.few} maintains accuracy across all nine cells while cheaper options fail on complex tasks.
sections.takeaway: Compare accuracy across domain and complexity cells; values below {criteria.cell_floor.threshold|pct} breach the minimum standard.

sections.headline: Few-shot prompting provides the necessary accuracy boost across all evaluated models.
sections.takeaway: Balanced accuracy across configurations; only configurations above {criteria.overall.threshold|pct} meet the aggregate bar.

sections.headline: {arm:brisk-s.few} avoids the confusion on complex turns that disqualifies {arm:nano-xs.few}.
sections.takeaway: Rows represent true complexity labels and columns indicate predicted classes.

explore.title: Constraint sensitivity analysis
explore.recomputes: Lowering the cell floor below the complex news drop makes {arm:nano-xs.few} eligible; raising the latency budget to {measure.latency_ms.atlas-m.zero.p95} ms unlocks {arm:atlas-m.zero}.

durable_claims.text: {arm:brisk-s.few} achieves {measure.balanced_accuracy.brisk-s.few.mean|pct} balanced accuracy at {measure.latency_ms.brisk-s.few.p95} ms latency while clearing the {criteria.cell_floor.threshold|pct} per-cell floor.
{arm:nano-xs.few} achieves {measure.balanced_accuracy.nano-xs.few.mean|pct} balanced accuracy but drops below the {criteria.cell_floor.threshold|pct} floor on complex turns.
